capabilities: Send the selected text or current line to Stockr as a stock via a command
Import today's or the last 7 days of Stockr entries into notes
Connect a Stockr account through a browser-based OAuth login in settings
disambiguation: Not a vault or file sync tool; it only exchanges reflection entries between Obsidian and the Stockr web app.
extras: README is written in Japanese. Using the plugin requires a Stockr contract (the README states there is no additional charge); OAuth 2.0 with PKCE is used and the plugin never handles passwords, requesting only read and post permissions. The README also outlines the source layout, including a minimal MCP client for the Stockr MCP server.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push note snippets to Stockr or pull its reflection entries back for daily notes and weekly reviews.

relations.evidence: 選択範囲（または現在行）をStockrにストック — コマンドパレットから1発

summary: Syncs selected note text to the Stockr reflective journaling app and imports today's or last-7-day Stockr entries into notes.
